messages:
maya: Quick proposal — go staggered: first prioritize Dedicated (capacity + baseline tenant isolation) so we can close revenue faster, then follow up with Private (VPC/KMS) next quarter. Rationale: lower infra effort, higher immediate reach. Thoughts?

samir: Sounds pragmatic. I'd split into an MVP for Dedicated (autoscaling, tenant isolation, billing) + a scoped Private prototype. How do we want to score/surface tradeoffs? RICE? impact vs effort? :thinking:

jess: From sales: most inbound mid-market asks can be satisfied with Dedicated if we promise Private timeline. A few enterprise deals insist on VPC day-1 though. If we can offer a clear paid roadmap/pilot, that helps close. Need explicit launch criteria for both.

oliver: Ops POV: Dedicated baseline is straightforward. Private adds orchestration (config, certs), networking work, and legal checklist. Ballpark: Dedicated ~3 team-sprints, Private ~8 sprints. That gap changes the RICE math.

maya: @oliver can you drop a quick RICE sketch? I did a light one:

```
Feature | Reach (%) | Impact (1-10) | Confidence | Effort (sprints) | RICE
Dedicated baseline | 50 | 7 | 0.8 | 3 | (50*7*0.8)/3 = 93.3
Private full | 20 | 9 | 0.6 | 8 | (20*9*0.6)/8 = 27
VPC-only (gate) | 15 | 8 | 0.7 | 4 | (15*8*0.7)/4 = 21
```

samir: Those are useful. Also add "operational risk" as a negative multiplier for Private (deploy surface + audits).

zach: SRE note: Private/on-prem will increase support overhead ~2x for the first 6 months. Recommend a 2-customer pilot with strong runbooks and a Solutions Eng buddy per pilot.

jess: :thumbsup: Pilot approach sells — we can sign an LOI with a canary clause: use Dedicated by default, ramp to Private when pilot passes security gate. That reduces legal friction.

maya: Proposed launch criteria draft:
- Dedicated GA: 95th-pctl latency SLO under expected load, billing+metering in console, onboarding docs and playbook, 3 internal sanity customers.
- Private Beta: KMS integrated, VPC peering validated, security checklist passed, 1 signed pilot with SOC questions answered, rollback plan.

oliver: Additions: automated rollback policy (traffic failover to Dedicated variant), and infra templates for customer infra (Helm/terraform snippets).

samir: Sequencing short plan:
1) Harden Dedicated infra + metrics, autoscale, cost telemetry (6w)
2) Prototype VPC peering + KMS integration (6w)
3) Private beta with 2 pilots + runbooks (8w)
4) Iterate to GA based on pilot feedback

maya: Pricing question: do we price Private as +% over Dedicated or as a fixed add-on? @jess will model.

jess: Recommend two-tier: (a) Hosted Private (VPC-managed + KMS) = +30-50% over Dedicated; (b) On-prem packaging = fixed license + premium support. Will run numbers.

zach: Also surface observability cost into the pricing model (prometheus retention, tracing). Ops bill needs to be covered.

maya: Next steps: align Legal + Solutions Eng, draft pilot contract template, and schedule a 30m roadmap sync. I'll book it. Thanks all :pray:

release-bot: Created doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/prioritization/dedicated-private-staggered-plan (internal)

jess: I'll ping key accounts and flag two pilot candidates.

maya: Great — capturing this as a decision checkpoint. I'll attach the RICE grid to the PRD.

samir: One more ask: track a risk dimension in the roadmap board (legal, infra, ops cost).

maya: noted, adding risk swimlanes.

oliver: If we need to shorten the Private timeline, we can scope VPC-only first as an incremental release. Less scope, faster time to pilot.

maya: Perfect. Sync scheduled. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
